title: Prayer Before Sleep
text:
Now I lay me down to sleep,
I pray the Lord my soul to keep.
If I should die before I wake,
I pray the Lord my soul to take.
Bless my family through the night,
and wake me with the morning light.
Amen.
notes: A simple evening prayer entrusting oneself to God's care during sleep. This prayer teaches children and adults to end the day with trust in God's protection and care.
